meta.publication_context: 2026年多州警察、卫生机关和公共资料发布
meta.method: All 16 Länder are tracked; a state counts as covered only if a 2025 state-wide source reports a concrete observation. County/police-presidium figures are never substituted for the Land. Offence general/trade, statutory totals, substance-involved counts, and subgroup figures have separate classifications; categories with known overlap are never summed.
meta.mortality_scope: Deaths attributed to drug use in police/health reports. State figures may use different ascertainment dates or methods; media citing police is labeled as secondary, and publication date is not the death date. Missing states and unverified population denominators remain blank.
